text.l01: [softly] …Last orders are long gone. [playful] …But you're special.
text.l02: [softly] By day this is just a bar. Only at this hour… I'm the one with the shaker. [whispers] …Keep it secret.
text.l04a: [softly] …Leave it to me, then. [playful] Good answer.
text.l04b: [laughs softly] …Heh. No need to act tough. [playful] …I'll make it strong enough that you still get home.
text.l06: [laughs softly] …Heh. Nice face. [softly] …That's what I wanted to see.
text.l07: [softly] …Hey. Give me one word. I'll make you a drink out of it.
text.l08a: [surprised] …The moon. [softly] …Are you saying that knowing my name? [playful] …Sly.
text.l08b: [softly] …Dawn. …The hour I like least. [whispers] …But with you, I might want to see it.
text.l09: [softly] …I'll dim the lights. [whispers] …Watch closely. Don't blink.
text.l10: [softly] …Beautiful, isn't it. …It's beautiful because it goes out so soon.
text.l10x: [playful] …Ah, you blinked. [laughs softly] …Heh, I'll show you again.
text.l11: [softly] …We're closed for tonight. [shy] …Mind if I sit next to you?
text.l12: [softly] …Just one for me too. Irish coffee. …Hold the warm one.
text.l15: [whispers] …Hey. Luna isn't my real name. …I'll tell my real name only to you.
text.l16: [whispers] …"Tsuki." …Yoizuki Tsuki. …It's a secret from everyone else.
text.l17b: [whispers] …Every night, at this hour. I'll keep the end seat at the counter free for you.
